1441964.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Warm and cool white LED icicle lights
- Durable black and white rubber cable
- Connectable up to 50m length
- Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience

## Information
Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 per cent twinkle. Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. Each set features long-lasting, energy-efficient LED bulbs for consistent, reliable performance. The robust rubber cable and waterproof connectors ensure durability in all weather conditions, making them suitable for year-round use. Choose between black or white cable to match your surroundings, and select from static or twinkle effects to suit your style. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional-quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance, and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

1442064.sourceDescription:
## Features
- String lights waterproof black rubber cable
- Flexible strong weatherproof cable easy install
- Energy efficient led bulbs warm cool rgb options

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.
